WHE.settings.title: Walls Have Ears
WHE.settings_tester.title: Activate during sounds preview
WHE.settings_tester.hint: Enable muffling sounds when ambient sound preview is enabled during sound editing.
WHE.settings_door_muffling.title: Enable door sound muffling
WHE.settings_door_muffling.hint: Enable dynamic muffling for door sounds when opening or closing doors based on wall occlusion.
WHE.settings_floor_thickness.title: Floor Thickness
WHE.settings_floor_thickness.hint: The maximum thickness (in grid units) to consider multiple floors as a single structural element for muffling purposes.
WHE.settings_hearing_height.title: Hearing Height Offset
WHE.settings_hearing_height.hint: The vertical offset (in grid units) above the token's base elevation where the 'ears' are located. This simulates the height of a creature's head (e.g. 6ft for humans).
WHE.settings_disable.title: Disable sound muffling
WHE.settings_disable.hint: This module allows for sounds to be muffled for improved inmersion. But you can disable this feature for performance reasons.
WHE.settings_debug.title: Enable Debug mode
WHE.settings_debug.hint: In order to troubleshoot your scenes, enable this to see the muffling index when selecting/moving your tokens.
WHE.config.hint: WALLS HAVE EARS: The muffling effect was removed from this screen as it will be dynamically handled by the module.
WHE.settings_echo_enable.title: Enable Echoes and Reverb
WHE.settings_echo_enable.hint: Enable dynamic algorithmic echo and reverberation based on room size and reflections.
WHE.settings_echo_rays.title: Number of Echo Raycasts
WHE.settings_echo_rays.hint: The number of rays to cast radially to estimate the room size and reflections. More rays increase precision but use more CPU.
WHE.settings_echo_exterior_threshold.hin: The average distance (in grid units) beyond which a space is considered an open exterior (disabling reverberation). Default is 120.
WHE.settings_echo_feedback.title: Echo Feedback Gain
WHE.settings_echo_feedback.hint: The feedback multiplier for the algorithmic echo loop (between 0.0 and 0.95). Larger values produce longer reverb tail.
WHE.settings_echo_dampening.title: Echo Dampening Frequency
WHE.settings_echo_dampening.hint: The cutoff frequency (in Hz) for the lowpass filter in the echo feedback loop. Lower values produce warmer/darker reverb.
